goal: Clarify bitcoin-cli documentation that setting the RPC client timeout to 0 uses the maximum supported timeout
Avoid misleading users into expecting no timeout when socket waits are actually capped at roughly 24 days
agreement: Broad support with no remaining open objections
Resolved objection regarding cast mismatches between CLI and socket timeouts (maflcko)
Concept and approach approval without stated technical reasons (pinheadmz, winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because it fixes inaccurate bitcoin-cli help text for -rpcclienttimeout=0
Informs users of the actual ~24-day cap rather than assuming requests can wait indefinitely
